567345acb12c264e.description: Head Equity Research (Mumbai) Company: Stack Wealth Job Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India Employment Type: Full-time Experience Required: 8 - 12 years Experience: 812+ years Company: Stack Wealth About the Role We are looking for a senior equity professional to lead and build Stack Wealths equity research function. Define entry levels, targets, risk parameters, investment thesis and exit/invalidation conditions for recommendations. Establish a disciplined process for tracking every recommendationfrom initiation to closure and regularly review hit rate, alpha, drawdowns and attribution. What Were Looking For 812+ years of relevant experience in equity research, portfolio management, PMS, institutional equities, brokerage research, wealth management or a similar investment role. Strong track record covering Indian equities across multiple sectors. Experience where research recommendations have directly influenced portfolios or client investment decisions. Robust understanding of fundamental analysis, financial modelling and valuation. Practical understanding of technical analysis, momentum and market behaviour; ability to combine these with fundamental research is strongly preferred. Experience in portfolio construction, position sizing and risk management. Demonstrated ability to distinguish between a good company and a good investment at the prevailing valuation. Strong decision-making discipline around both buying and selling stocks. Experience managing and reviewing the work of equity analysts. Ability to communicate complex investment ideas simply to clients and non-research teams. High ownership mindsetthe role requires accountability for outcomes, not simply producing research. Relevant NISM certifications are preferred. CFA / CA / MBA Finance or other investment qualifications would be an added advantage. Why Stack Wealth Stack Wealth is building a technology-led wealth management platform for Indian investors, combining personalised advisory, investment research and AI-enabled wealth management. This role offers the opportunity to build and own the equity research function rather than inherit a narrowly defined analyst role. You will work closely with the founders and senior leadership and have direct visibility into how research gets translated into products, portfolios and client outcomes. .

REMOTE JOB OPPORTUNITY

Bilingual Social Media Content Creator & Customer Service Assistant

Atomic Flooring / Atomic Construction

Location: Remote — Latin America preferred
Pay: $250 USD per week
Schedule: Full-time, approximately 40 hours per week
Languages: Excellent English required; Spanish fluency strongly preferred

About Our Company

Atomic Flooring is a growing flooring and construction company serving the Phoenix, Arizona market. We help homeowners transform their spaces with quality flooring and professional service. We’re looking for a creative, dependable, and organized remote team member to help grow our online presence, create engaging social media content, communicate with potential customers, and manage incoming sales leads.

What You’ll Do

Social Media Content Creation

·       Turn photos and video clips we provide into attractive, professional social media content.

·       Create short-form videos and Reels featuring completed flooring projects, before-and-after transformations, and product highlights.

·       Add captions, text overlays, music, transitions, and branding to make content engaging.

·       Create graphics, promotional posts, and special offers using tools such as Canva.

·       Write compelling captions in English, with Spanish content when appropriate.

·       Help manage our Facebook and Instagram accounts and maintain a consistent posting schedule.

·       Develop creative ideas for showcasing our work and attracting new customers.

·       Repurpose existing photos and videos into multiple pieces of marketing content.

·       Monitor engagement and recommend ways to improve content and reach.

Customer Service & Lead Management

·       Respond promptly to incoming leads from our website, social media, text messages, and other sources.

·       Communicate professionally with potential customers by text, phone, email, and messaging apps.

·       Follow up with prospects who have requested information or estimates.

·       Ask basic questions about customers’ flooring projects and gather information our sales team needs.

·       Schedule estimates and appointments for our team.

·       Keep customer information and follow-up activities organized.

·       Provide a friendly, professional customer experience that reflects our company well.

Administrative & Marketing Support

·       Assist with promotions, marketing campaigns, and business development.

·       Help organize leads, appointments, and customer communications.

·       Research marketing ideas, trends, and opportunities.

·       Assist with administrative tasks as our business grows.

·       Take initiative and help improve our marketing and customer service processes.

Qualifications

Required

·       Excellent written and spoken English.

·       Strong communication and customer service skills, including a professional phone manner.

·       Reliable internet connection and a suitable computer.

·       Good organizational skills and attention to detail.

·       Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and learn new tools.

·       Availability during agreed-upon hours that overlap with Arizona business hours.

Strongly preferred

·       Fluency in both English and Spanish.

·       Experience creating social media content for businesses.

·       Experience editing short videos for Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, or TikTok.

·       Familiarity with Canva and video editing tools such as CapCut.

·       Experience managing Facebook and Instagram business accounts.

·       Experience handling sales inquiries, following up with leads, and booking appointments.

·       Experience working with U.S. businesses.

The Ideal Candidate

We want someone who is creative, proactive, dependable, and comfortable wearing several hats. You should be able to take a few photos or short video clips we send you and turn them into polished, professional content that captures a potential customer’s attention. You should also be comfortable communicating with customers, responding to inquiries quickly, and helping turn incoming leads into scheduled estimates. We value people who take ownership of their work, suggest improvements, and want to grow with the business.

Compensation & Schedule

Starting compensation is $250 USD per week for full-time work, approximately 40 hours per week. The schedule will be coordinated to provide coverage during agreed-upon hours that overlap with Arizona business hours.

How to Apply

Please send us:

1.     A brief introduction about yourself and your experience.

2.     Your country of residence and time zone.

3.     Your English and Spanish proficiency levels.

4.     Examples or links to social media content and short videos you have created.

5.     The video editing, graphic design, and social media tools you use.

6.     Your experience with customer service, phone calls, and lead follow-up.

7.     Confirmation that you are comfortable with the proposed compensation and working schedule.

Please include links to examples of your actual work. Candidates who demonstrate strong content creation skills will receive priority consideration.

We look forward to finding someone who can help us grow our brand, connect with customers, and become a valuable member of our team.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/atomic-construction-llc-marketing-appt-setting

56dbe0d041559c5f.description: **About AptEdge** We build AI agents for B2B technical support. The agent pulls from everything a support org already has (tickets, docs, CRM, chat, bugs, codebase) and works a case the way a good senior engineer would, from investigation to resolution. We live inside the tools support teams already use: Zendesk, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Slack, Jira, Confluence. Backed by top VCs and Founders. **The Role** Every customer we sign has to go from contract to a working, trusted AI agent workflow, and you're the person who gets them there. You'll set up their integrations, tune what the agent can see and say, write the runbooks that tell it how that customer resolves a given class of ticket, and stay close enough afterward to know when something has drifted. Most of that is configuration. Some of it is code, and when it is, you'll write it yourself rather than filing a ticket and waiting. You'll be part of our Customer Success org, because the role is evaluated on whether customers adopt, expand, and renew. You'll also spend time working with the R&D team. When you find something in a deployment that's a product problem and not a config problem, you should be able to walk over and fix it, or at least get it fixed fast. **What You'll Work On** **Getting customers live** Setting up integrations, SSO and SAML, IT and systems administration, and checking that what we’re integrated with is actually what they meant to give us. Co-ordinate with customers and admin/IT teams over calls and async to run enablement. **Customizing the product** Overall setup, prompt engineering, search filters, ranking, how answers get formatted, branding, embeds. Whatever it takes to make AptEdge feel native to that customer. **Data understanding and engineering** Sometimes it's the source data. Sometimes it's indexing, a filter, or a prompt. You'll trace it through pipelines, logs, and the database and fix the layer that's actually broken. **Technical Prompt Engineering** Work on a live LLM powered platform that empowers very technical engineers and agents to deliver business value. Understand data in depth to understand build agentic workflows and pipelines. **Writing some code** Building and fixing connectors, self-service features, ingestion for the odd knowledge sources customers throw at us, and internal tooling so the third time we do a customization it's a setting instead of a project. **Monitoring and optimizing customer health** Reporting on usage and resolution per account, alongside CS. You'll see a stalled deployment before the customer does and know how to unstick it. **Growing accounts** You'll own the technical half of expansion: scoping new use cases, discovering value, empowering business partners, and coordinating with internal go-to-market and engineering teams. **You Need** * 5+ years in solutions, implementation, and backend engineering at a B2B SaaS company * To have supported an LLM or RAG product that real customers used in production * Solid Python and TypeScript, and comfort working in a large codebase in collaboration with engineering teams * Hands-on experience with enterprise identity (SAML, OAuth2, SSO) and third-party APIs, including the ugly parts: rate limits, webhooks, eventual consistency, prompt engineering & testing * Clear written and spoken English to communicate with customers and IT/engineering teams. * Availability for customer calls through US working hours. The rest of your day is yours to arrange. * Experience with cloud and debugging tools such as GCP/AWS, Sentry, PagerDuty, etc. **It Helps If You Have** * Admin or config experience in Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, or ServiceNow * Direct experience supporting live, production-grade retrieval-augmented generation systems * Background with Kubernetes or React web applications * A feel for the commercial side. You know adoption is what drives renewal, and you can tell a customer who's stuck from one who's just not using it * A habit of owning problems from beginning to end, including identifying opportunities to be proactive in support of customer or internal goals. * Previous working experience as a Support Engineer **How We Work** * Small team, high ownership. Small PRs, and we pair when a problem is hard * Customer-facing engineers ship code here. Your work goes in the main repo and gets reviewed as per engineering contribution process * CS and R&D look at the same customer data. You'll be in both rooms and carry context between them
